'''Adon-Iarr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], was aboard the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] ''[[Ziost Shadow]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
